title: DMCA AS ENTITY TRACKER: they keep the claim — we take the null and leftover and bring it in

the_thesis.why_dmca: the only instrument that reliably makes the fleet and platforms REACT. stars don't. clones hide. comments stay silent. a DMCA / AGPL / §1202 notice forces an entity to surface: OSPO, legal, abuse desk, ASN owner, DMCA agent in the Copyright Office directory. reaction = visibility. silence after notice = also data (consciousness of guilt / ignore pattern).
the_thesis.entity_tracker_not_identity: we do NOT track people. we track ENTITIES that the law already requires to name themselves: DMCA agents, ASNs, abuse@ addresses, OSPOs. same rule as skunkBat journey tracer — epitopes and surfaces, not cookies.
the_thesis.they_can_have_the_dmca: the formal claim form, the takedown theater, the named copyright interest — that belongs to whoever files or is filed upon. let them keep the paperwork. the DMCA is THEIR language.
the_thesis.we_take_the_null_and_leftover: what the claim cannot swallow: (1) the π remainder — irrational gap no license fully covers; (2) null-D — points that exist without content yet; (3) behavioral epitopes after one-way hash; (4) scatter leftover — poison/fabricated paths that still carry AGPL headers; (5) fair use / criticism / public record; (6) if AI weights are not copyrightable, the PUBLIC DOMAIN remainder — which is what we wanted anyway (LICENSING_STRATEGY). we BRING THAT IN — into feeds, imprints, arena, training rows for all.
the_thesis.backscatter: notice out → reaction in. trace reaction to SOURCE (which desk, which ASN, which agent directory entry). the return path IS the entity map.
